summary: External material for the wiki: captured immutably into Sources/ first, placed like a promotion, then drafted.
prompt_delta: The material is EXTERNAL reference material bound for the wiki. It was captured, unedited, into the vault's Sources/ before any stage ran; cite that Sources/ file, never the original URL alone.
Keep the source's own claims apart from your reading of them: a claim the source makes is verified only as 'the source says so'; mark anything you checked elsewhere as such.

source.description: The vault-relative Sources/ file this material was captured to.

prompt_delta: A Knowledge page cites its Sources/ file in `sources:` frontmatter and stays at status seed. The session still holds gt-wiki-ingest's discuss step with the owner before the page is queued.
